constraints.anchors: {word, lead_frames} only; never seconds or frames; event frame = word start - lead_frames
constraints.lead_frames: kinetic word -3, graphic state change -2, shot cut -4..-6 (inside a pause >= 200 ms), counter starts at the number word
constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)
constraints.coverage: every sentence >= 1 anchored event; >= 80 % of sentences a mechanism event; every spoken number and every first-mention term on screen
constraints.kinetic: 8-20 kinetic words per minute; <= 6 words and <= 2 lines on screen; impact word 1-2 words
constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero
constraints.text: text on busy backgrounds needs a plate or halo; sizes and safe areas: 04 sections 3.2 and 3.4
banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)

sentences.ar: الـneuron عبارة عن مجموع مرجّح وليه رأي في الصفر.
sentences.en: A neuron is a weighted sum with an opinion about zero.

sentences.ar: اضرب كل input في weight، زوّد bias، وعدّي النتيجة على activation function.
sentences.en: Multiply each input by a weight, add a bias, and pass the result through an activation function.

sentences.ar: وكل رقم في الجملة دي على الشاشة، محسوب على عميل حقيقي ما فيش حاجة مخبّية جوه الصندوق.
sentences.en: Every number in that sentence is on screen, computed on one real customer — there is nothing hidden inside the box.

sentences.ar: والـactivation أهم مما تبدو: من غير لا خطية، إنك تركّب طبقات ما بيدّيكش حاجة، لأن دالة خطية لدالة خطية لسه دالة خطية.
sentences.en: The activation matters more than it looks: without a nonlinearity, stacking layers gives you nothing, because a linear function of a linear function is still a linear function.

sentences.ar: والانحناءة هي اللي بتخلّي الشبكة تمثّل حاجة الخط المستقيم مش قادر عليها.
sentences.en: The bend is what lets a network represent something a straight line cannot.

sentences.ar: والـlayer عبارة عن neurons بتشارك نفس الـinputs، والشبكة طبقات بتقرا outputs بعض.
sentences.en: A layer is just neurons sharing the same inputs, and a network is layers reading each other's outputs.

sentences.ar: عدّ الـparameters بنفسك بدل ما حد يقولك الرقم ده مصدر حجم النموذج فعلاً.
sentences.en: Count the parameters yourself rather than being told the number — that is where the size of a model actually comes from.

sentences.ar: ودلوقتي الجزء اللي صوته صوفي وهو مش كده.
sentences.en: Now the part that sounds mystical and is not.

sentences.ar: شغّل الـforward pass، هات تنبؤ، وقيس هو غلط قد إيه: دي الـloss.
sentences.en: Run the forward pass, get a prediction, and measure how wrong it is: that is the loss.

sentences.ar: وبعدها اسأل سؤال تقدر تجاوبه بقاعدة السلسلة: لو زقّيت الـweight ده شوية، الـloss هتتغير إزاي؟
sentences.en: Then ask a question you can answer with the chain rule: if I nudged this one weight, how would the loss change?
That is the gradient — a slope with a sign.

sentences.ar: حرّك الـweight في الاتجاه اللي بيقلّل الـloss، شوية.
sentences.en: Step the weight in the direction that reduces the loss, a little.
Do it again — that is training.

sentences.ar: وحجم الخطوة مش تفصيلة: بصّ على الـloss وهي بتنزل بهدوء،
sentences.en: And the step size is not a detail: watch the loss descend smoothly,

sentences.ar: وبعدها زوّد الـlearning rate فوق حوالي صفر فاصل تلاتة وخمسة وبصّ عليها وهي بتتشتت على الشاشة، لأن الحساب نفسه بيتشتت.
sentences.en: then raise the learning rate past roughly zero point three five and watch it diverge on screen, because the arithmetic genuinely diverges.

sentences.ar: وكل نموذج في باقي الفيديو ده هو اللوب دي، متكررة على حجم كبير.
sentences.en: Every model in the rest of this film is this loop, repeated at scale.

facts.rule: A number goes on screen with its fact id as `ref`/`data_refs`. `unmatched_numbers` are spoken but have no data-contract fact: their source is the sentence itself (a valid `s:` ref); never replace them with a different figure.

referenced.ctx: Gradient descent diverges above a learning rate of about 0.35 — because the arithmetic diverges, not because it was scripted to.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.
glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

concepts.def_en: The basic unit of a neural network: it computes a weighted sum of its inputs plus a bias, then applies an activation.
concepts.def_ar: الوحدة الأساسية في الشبكة العصبية: بتحسب مجموع مرجّح للمدخلات زائد bias، وبعدين بتطبّق activation.
concepts.failure: Forgetting the activation; without it stacked neurons collapse into one linear function.

concepts.def_en: A learned number on a connection in a neural network that scales an input; training adjusts weights to reduce the loss.
concepts.def_ar: الـweight رقم متعلَّم على الاتصال في الـneural network بيضرب في الـinput، والـtraining بيعدّله عشان يقلّل الـloss.
concepts.failure: Confusing weights (learned) with hyperparameters like learning rate (set by you).

concepts.def_en: A non-linear function applied to a neuron's weighted sum, bending the output so stacked layers can learn more than straight lines.
concepts.def_ar: الـactivation دالة غير خطية بتتطبق على مجموع الـneuron، بتكسر الخطية عشان الطبقات المتراصة تتعلم أكتر من خطوط مستقيمة.
concepts.failure: Stacking layers without activations; the whole network collapses into one linear model.

concepts.def_en: A named, reusable block of code that takes inputs, does a calculation and returns a value.
concepts.failure: Forgetting return, so the function silently gives back None.

concepts.def_en: Running inputs through the network layer by layer, multiplying by weights and applying activations, to produce a prediction.
concepts.def_ar: الـforward pass إنك تمرّر المدخلات في الشبكة طبقة ورا طبقة، تضرب في الـweights وتطبّق الـactivations، عشان تطلع prediction.
concepts.failure: Forgetting that the forward pass only predicts; weights change only after loss and backpropagation.

concepts.def_en: A number measuring how wrong a model's prediction is; training adjusts weights to make it…
concepts.failure: Judging a model by training loss alone; it keeps falling while test error rises.

concepts.def_en: The slope of the loss with respect to a weight; it shows which way, and how strongly, to change that weight to reduce the loss.
concepts.def_ar: الـgradient هو ميل الـloss بالنسبة لـweight: بيقولك تغيّر الـweight في أنهي اتجاه وقد إيه عشان الـloss تقل.
concepts.failure: Moving along the gradient instead of against it, which increases the loss.

concepts.def_en: The step size used to update model weights at each training iteration; too small is slow, too large overshoots and diverges.
concepts.def_ar: الـlearning rate هو حجم الخطوة اللي بنعدّل بيها الـweights في كل تكرار؛ صغير يبطّئ، وكبير يعدّي الهدف ويـdiverge.
concepts.failure: Setting it too high makes loss blow up; too low looks like training never converges.

concepts.def_en: A construct that repeats a block of code for each item or until a condition changes.
concepts.failure: Off-by-one bounds, or a condition that never changes, looping forever.
